name: Particle-based Iso-surface Ray Casting
definition: Rendering fluid surface directly by extracting an iso-surface of a field quantity φ. Uses arbitrary field quantity φ(x): R^3 -> R with iso-value φ_iso. Common choices for φ include density ρ, surface distance function [ZB05], or anisotropic surface distance function [YT13].
summary: Particle-based Iso-surface Ray Casting renders fluid surfaces by ray casting through particle-defined scalar fields, avoiding voxelization errors while maintaining high visual fidelity.
